@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@

+/interface bridge add name=bridge vlan-filtering=yes
+/interface wireless set [ find default-name=wlan1 ] band=2ghz-b/g/n channel-width=20/40mhz-XX disabled=no distance=indoors frequency=auto installation=outdoor mode=ap-bridge name=wlan2.4-evn-net-20 ssid=evn-net-21 wireless-protocol=802.11
+/interface wireless set [ find default-name=wlan2 ] band=5ghz-a/n/ac channel-width=20/40/80mhz-XXXX distance=indoors frequency=auto installation=outdoor mode=ap-bridge name=wlan5-evn-net-20 ssid=evn-net-22 wireless-protocol=802.11

+/ip dhcp-client add interface=vlan3501-manage
+/ip user-8 profile set [ find default=yes ] html-directory=user-8
+/system clock set time-zone-name=America/Los_Angeles
+/system identity set name=noc-ap
+/system logging add action=disk topics=critical
+/system logging add action=disk topics=error
+/system logging add action=disk topics=info

+/system routerboard settings set auto-upgrade=yes
+/tool bandwidth-server set authenticate=no
